name: bronto-pulse-review
description: Review private project evidence across repositories, packages and websites with Bronto Pulse.

interface.longDescription: Review an existing private Pulse installation, inspect source dates and coverage, and choose a useful next check. Local pilot integration; no automatic collection or account changes.
defaultPrompt: Review my projects and tell me what deserves attention.
Review the evidence around my latest release.
Help me investigate a change in my project metrics.
